findings.title: Gift to "It's for me" switch keeps the recipient's name and email as the buyer's
findings.steps: Click Give it as a gift, fill Parents' names and Their email, then pick It's for me.
findings.expected: Your name and Your email start empty (or keep the buyer's own email).
findings.actual: They hold the parents' name and email, so the building link goes to the parents.
findings.fix: Keep separate state per option, or clear both fields when switching.

findings.title: On phones, Pay $58 sits above the book preview
findings.steps: At 375 px wide, build a book and open Review and order.
findings.expected: The buyer sees their book before reaching Pay.
findings.actual: Pay is at about 2,350 px down the page; Your book starts at about 2,509 px.
findings.fix: On small screens add a Preview your book step or a sticky preview button above the order form.

findings.title: Gift send date has no default, no minimum and no hint
findings.steps: Open Give it as a gift and look at Send the gift card on.
findings.expected: Defaults to today, rejects past dates, says when it sends.
findings.actual: Blank, accepts past dates (no min), nothing says what blank means. [Guessing] on server handling of blank or past dates.
findings.fix: Default to today, set min to today, show 'Sends today' under the field.

findings.title: Two page counts disagree: 20 of 20 pages vs 7 of 13
findings.steps: Build a book with 8 people and look at the preview.
findings.actual: Badge says 20 of 20 pages; the page turner says N of 13.
findings.fix: Count spreads in the turner (Spread 7 of 13), or drop the badge once the book is full.

findings.title: "It's for me" keeps the gift header copy
findings.steps: Open Give it as a gift, pick It's for me.
findings.actual: Header still says 'The parents get a link to add their photos.'
findings.fix: Swap to 'You get a link to build it whenever the photos are ready.'

findings.title: Gift form doesn't say where extra copies ship
findings.steps: Open Give it as a gift, look at Extra copies.
findings.expected: Says copies ship with the book to the parents.
findings.actual: No address asked and no note on where copies go.
findings.fix: Add 'Extra copies ship with the book to the parents.'

findings.title: Gift panel doesn't say what happens if the parents never build
findings.steps: Read the Give it as a gift panel.
findings.expected: Says whether the gift expires or can be refunded.
findings.actual: Nothing on the panel. [Guessing] whether the FAQ covers it.
findings.fix: Add one line on expiry and refunds near Pay.
